transcript:
## COMMITTEE ON ADMINISTRATION/INFORMATION SYSTEMS

November 17, 2026 at 6:30 PM

Chairman Fajardo called the meeting to order.

The Clerk called the roll.

Present: Aldermen Fajardo, Kantor, Bonilla, Kaw-uh, Sapienza

1. Communication from Charleen Michaud, Welfare Director, requesting amendments to the City's current Welfare Guidelines to align with the recent changes to RSA 165.

On motion of Alderman Bonilla , duly seconded by Alderman Kaw-uh , it was voted to approve.

There being no further business, on motion of Alderman Sapienza , duly seconded by

Alderman Bonilla , it was voted to adjourn.

A True Record. Attest.

Clerk of Committee
